meta.note: Curated subset for a classroom triage prototype. Summaries are in plain English and are not a substitute for the official text (ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj). Covers four risk tiers plus scope.

provisions.title: Harmful manipulation and deception
provisions.summary: Bans AI using subliminal, manipulative or deceptive techniques that distort a person's behaviour and cause significant harm.

provisions.title: Exploitation of vulnerabilities
provisions.summary: Bans AI that exploits vulnerabilities due to age, disability or socio-economic situation to distort behaviour and cause harm.

provisions.title: Social scoring
provisions.summary: Bans evaluating or classifying people over time from behaviour or traits where it leads to detrimental or unjustified treatment.

provisions.title: Predictive policing based on profiling
provisions.summary: Bans predicting the risk of a person committing a crime based solely on profiling or personality traits.

provisions.title: Untargeted facial scraping
provisions.summary: Bans building or expanding facial recognition databases through untargeted scraping of images from the internet or CCTV.

provisions.title: Emotion recognition at work or school
provisions.summary: Bans inferring emotions of people in workplaces and educational institutions, except for medical or safety reasons.

provisions.title: Biometric categorisation of sensitive traits
provisions.summary: Bans biometric categorisation that infers race, political opinions, trade-union membership, religion, or sexual orientation.

provisions.title: Real-time remote biometric identification for law enforcement
provisions.summary: Bans live remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement, subject to narrow exceptions.

provisions.title: High-risk classification route
provisions.summary: A system is high-risk when its intended purpose falls within one of the areas listed in Annex III.

provisions.title: Derogation from high-risk
provisions.summary: An Annex III system is not high-risk if it performs a narrow procedural task, improves a prior human activity, or does not materially influence the outcome.

provisions.title: Biometrics
provisions.summary: Remote biometric identification, biometric categorisation, and emotion recognition, where such use is permitted and not prohibited.

provisions.title: Critical infrastructure
provisions.summary: Safety components in the management of road traffic, and supply of water, gas, heating and electricity.

provisions.title: Education and vocational training
provisions.summary: Admissions, evaluating learning outcomes, assigning people to institutions, and monitoring/proctoring exams.

provisions.title: Employment and workers
provisions.summary: Recruitment, screening and filtering applications, and decisions on promotion, termination, task allocation or performance evaluation.

provisions.title: Access to essential services
provisions.summary: Eligibility for public benefits, creditworthiness and credit scoring, risk pricing in life and health insurance, and emergency dispatch.

provisions.title: Law enforcement
provisions.summary: Assessing the risk of offending or victimisation, polygraphs, evidence reliability, and profiling in the course of law enforcement.

provisions.title: Migration, asylum and border control
provisions.summary: Risk assessments, examination of applications, and verification of documents for migration, asylum and border control.

provisions.title: Justice and democratic processes
provisions.summary: Assisting judicial authorities in researching and interpreting facts and law, and influencing elections or voting behaviour.

provisions.title: Interactive AI disclosure
provisions.summary: Systems that interact directly with people must inform them they are dealing with an AI, unless it is obvious.

provisions.title: Synthetic content marking
provisions.summary: Providers must mark AI-generated audio, image, video or text as artificially generated, in a machine-readable way.

provisions.title: Emotion/biometric disclosure
provisions.summary: Deployers of emotion recognition or biometric categorisation (where permitted) must inform the people exposed to it.

provisions.title: Deepfake and public-interest text labelling
provisions.summary: Deployers must disclose deepfakes and AI-generated text published to inform the public on matters of public interest.

provisions.title: Scope and exclusions
provisions.summary: The Act does not apply to systems used purely for scientific R&D, pre-market testing, purely personal non-professional use, or certain national-security and military uses.

provisions.title: Minimal risk (no specific obligations)
provisions.summary: Systems that are not prohibited, not high-risk and not subject to transparency duties carry no mandatory obligations beyond AI literacy and voluntary codes.
